correctness.rationale: The displayed bracket equals a three-by-two times two-by-three product projected away from a single coordinate, with a factor q^16 from arbitrary central inputs. Full-product counts split by first-factor rank and yield N0,N1,N2. Exhaustive Schur-complement and rank-one/zero analyses cover every target. Multiplicity formulas follow from GL2, rank-one corner and line counts and sum to q^8. All q=2 and q=3 vertex-pair fibers checked exhaustively; no empirical extrapolation is used for the field-general proof. Rank decomposition proves width two and a positive unreachable stratum proves sharpness.
